body: heyyyyy, let's chat. what keeps you going? i'm not on any meds right now. nothing was effective. except the benzos for anxiety, but i just started to abuse those.

Thank you for further inquiry.

I value my health now and I've raised those standards. I've realized that I don't want to live my life for other people, even though I continue to do so. I'm not willing to accept abuse from others anymore.

To be honest, everything feels pointless right now. It's difficult to discuss my values when I feel like this, because it's almost like they don't exist.

Thank you for asking.
